# Lupo Dumpster Rentals

> Lupo Enterprises LLC (doing business as Lupo Dumpster Rentals) is a locally owned dumpster rental and junk removal company based in Holiday, FL. We deliver 10, 15, and 20-yard dumpsters across Pasco, Pinellas, Hillsborough, and Hernando counties at flat rates starting at $325.

## About

- **Legal name:** Lupo Enterprises LLC
- **Brand:** Lupo Dumpster Rentals
- **Based in:** 5647 Andrea Dr, Holiday, FL 34690, USA
- **Phone:** [(727) 317-6717](tel:+17273176717)
- **Email:** a.lupollc@gmail.com
- **Website:** <https://www.lupodumpsterrentals.com>
- **Hours:** Open 7 days, 7 AM – 8 PM
- **Founded:** 2020 by Alex Lupo and Amanda Lupo
- **Rating:** 5.0 out of 5 from 160+ Google reviews

## Dumpster sizes and flat-rate prices

- [10-Yard Dumpster](https://www.lupodumpsterrentals.com/services/10-yard-dump-trailer): $325 flat. 12' L × 8' W × 3.5' H. About 3 pickup-truck loads. 2 tons included. Best for garage cleanouts, small remodels, yard debris.
- [15-Yard Dumpster](https://www.lupodumpsterrentals.com/services/15-yard-dump-trailer): $400 flat. 14' L × 8' W × 4' H. About 4–5 pickup-truck loads. 3 tons included. Best for kitchen remodels, flooring tear-outs, mid-size cleanouts.
- [20-Yard Dumpster](https://www.lupodumpsterrentals.com/services/20-yard-dump-trailer): $500 flat. 16' L × 8' W × 5' H. About 6–7 pickup-truck loads. 4 tons included. Best for whole-home renovations, roofing jobs, full property cleanouts.

Every rental includes: Delivery & pickup in our service area; Disposal & dump fees up to the weight limit; Driveway-safe placement on protective boards; Call when you're done — we haul it away.

Common accepted materials: Household junk and furniture; Construction and remodel debris; Drywall, lumber, and flooring; Roofing shingles; Yard waste, branches, and palm fronds; Cabinets, fixtures, and old carpet. Call to confirm anything hazardous.
